ABOUT PLAYSCOUT

Editorial and player contribution policy

How editors turn official updates and player experience into useful, accountable game help.

Answer the player’s decision

Every guide starts with the task a player wants to complete. The quick answer appears before background, and each step explains its resource cost, version assumptions and likely failure point.

Labels carry meaning

Official source describes first-party material. Editor verified means an editor checked the claim. Player tested records hands-on experience. These labels cannot be added by an automated rewrite alone.

Corrections and updates

Material changes update the visible modified date and revision note. Expired codes and outdated strategies remain out of current lists. News pages link into durable game hubs so useful context survives after the headline ages.

Community contributions

Player tips need a game version, clear reproduction steps and permission to publish. Editors rewrite for clarity, preserve attribution and separate observation from confirmed game rules.

TRANSPARENCY

Check platform and source

Apple rows are iOS/iPadOS only. GamerPower offers and FreeToGame catalog entries keep their own platform labels. Editorial claims and codes require separate verification.
